payment_stripe.secret_key.label: Secret key
payment_stripe.secret_key.help: Your Stripe secret key. sk_test_ is test mode, sk_live_ charges real cards. Kept hidden.
payment_stripe.currency.label: Currency
payment_stripe.currency.help: Automatic charges in your shop's currency. A choice that does not match the sale's currency is declined, never charged.
payment_stripe.reader_id.label: Card reader ID
payment_stripe.reader_id.help: The Stripe reader for this till. Leave empty for a test charge, which works only with an sk_test_ key.
